Earlier this year in May, OpenAI launched a dedicated mobile application for enterprise users. Now, SpaceXAI is rolling out a similar product for Grok.

Grok for Intune is now available

The enterprise-exclusive app is called Grok for Intune. SpaceXAI stated that the newly launched dedicated app is the "Microsoft Intune version of Grok — xAI's AI assistant — designed for organizations that use Intune to manage apps and data".

The company noted: "The app supports Intune mobile application management, adheres to organizational app protection policies, and allows sign-in using a corporate email account."

SpaceXAI listed the key features of Grok for Intune as follows:

AI assistant Ask anything anytime to get quick answers; conduct in-depth research online; or tackle challenging problems in math, science, and coding. Upload files and photos, or paste links, and let Grok analyse and explain the content. Grok Imagine generates stunning images from short text prompts, or upload images for Grok to edit — remove objects, transform scenes, or apply any artistic style. Create videos with sound using text prompts, or turn static photos into videos. Voice mode Talk to Grok and get natural, smooth voice replies without lifting a finger. Live camera: Share what you see and let Grok analyse and reason about it in real time. Real-time information With access to the web and X platform data, Grok's answers stay on top of the latest news, trends, and developments on any topic. Built for managed devices Deployed and configured by your organization's IT team through Microsoft Intune. Adheres to organizational app protection policies, including restrictions on storage, sharing, and data transfer. Sign in with corporate email. No in-app purchases.

Grok for Intune is now available on the App Store.
